title: Disguised duplicate
summary: The same rental invoice arrives a second time. The vendor name and the reference are written differently, but the amount, the invoice date and the billing period are identical to a payment that was already made.

title: Legitimate recurring bill
summary: The March storage bill. It has the same vendor and the same amount as the bills paid in earlier months, but a new reference and a new billing period. That is what a normal monthly bill looks like.

title: Ambiguous case
summary: A similarly named vendor bills the same amount 16 days after a paid invoice, with no reference and no billing period to compare. The records cannot settle whether this is a second bill for the same job, so a person has to check.
